nameOverride.description: Suffix of the name, instead of the name of the object.

gatewayClassName.description: The name of the GatewayClass resource that this Gateway references.

targetSelector.description: Name-based selector for automatic GatewayClass linking. When set, automatically references the specified `gatewayClass.$name`.

type.description: Type of the address, like `IPAddress` or `Hostname`. Defaults to `IPAddress` in Gateway API.

value.description: The address value, like an IP address or a hostname.

items.description: A requested address for the gateway.

addresses.description: Requested addresses for the gateway. Passed as is.

infrastructure.description: Infrastructure settings of the gateway. Passed as is.

annotations.description: Annotations for the resources created for the gateway.

labels.description: Labels for the resources created for the gateway.

group.description: API group of the parameters resource.

parametersRef.description: Implementation specific parameters of the gateway.

from.description: Namespaces from which ListenerSets may attach. Valid options are All, Selector, Same, and None.

namespaces.description: Namespaces from which ListenerSets may attach.

allowedListeners.description: Configure `namespaces.from` as `Same`, `All`, `Selector`, or `None` to control which ListenerSets may attach. Set `namespaces.selector` when `from` is `Selector`.

tls.description: Gateway wide TLS settings. Passed as is.

frontend.description: TLS settings for connections from clients, passed on as is.

additionalProperties.description: A setting passed on as is.

backend.description: TLS settings for connections to backends, passed on as is.

additionalProperties.description: A setting passed on as is.

listeners.description:
Array of listener definitions that define the network ports and protocols the Gateway listens on.

Each listener must specify:
- `name`: Unique name for the listener
- `port`: Network port to listen on
- `protocol`: Protocol (HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, TLS, UDP)
- `hostname`: Optional hostname filter
- `tls`: Optional TLS configuration
- `allowedRoutes`: Optional configuration for which routes can attach
